MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  DECEMBER 17, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  4:30 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Riggins called the meeting to order at 4:45p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Marianne Riggins; Mayor Pro Tern Bruce Silverstein; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Doug Stewart and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Candace Bond, Interim City
  Manager; Richard Rojas, Deputy City Manager; Yolanda Bundy, Community
  Development Director; Director; Tyler Eaton, Assistant Community Development
  Director; Parker Davis, Media Technician; Christina Munoz, Deputy City Clerk; Jason
  Lawrence, Deputy City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Mayor Riggins led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Deputy City Clerk Muiioz reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  November 17, 2025.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Councilmember moved, and Mayor Riggins seconded a motion to approve the
  agenda and adjourn in memory of Rob and Michele Reiner. The motion carried
  unanimously.

ITEM 1  ORDINANCES AND PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  Appeal of Planning Commission Resolution No. 25-38 Regarding Conditional Use
  Permit No. 22-004 — An application for a conditional use permit to allow for an
  emergency communication facility to serve the Los Angeles County Sheriffs
  substation located at the Santa Monica Community College site (23525 Civic
  Center Way, APN 4458-022-906, Owner, County of Los Angeles; Appellant,
  Malibu Township Council)
  Recommended Action: Consider Resolution No. 25-50 (Exhibit A) and Appeal No.
  25-005, determine if the project complies with the Malibu Municipal Code and the
  California Environmental Quality Act; and 1) Direct staff to return with a resolution
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of Decemeber17, 2025
  Page 2 of 3

  matching the Council's decision; or 2) Adopt the attached draft resolution denying
  the appeal and upholding the Planning Commission decision approving Conditional
  Use Permit No. 22-004 to allow for an emergency communication facility at the
  Los Angeles County Sheriffs substation on the Santa Monica College-Malibu
  Campus to be utilized by the County of Los Angeles within the Institutional Zoning
  District at 23525 Civic Center Way (County of Los Angeles).

  Disclosures: Councilmembers Conrad, Stewart, Uhring, Mayor Pro Tern
  Silverstein, and Mayor Riggins

  Assistant Community Development Director Eaton presented the staff report.

  The Council directed questions to staff.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Jo Drummond, Zack (Los Angeles County), Captain Can, Deputy Chief
  DuVally, Anne K., Kevin Keegan, Scott Dittrich, Colin Drummond, Patt Healy,
  Norm Haynie, Jan Ravlich, Tiffany Murray, Ryan Embree, Howard Rutski, Danny
  Smith, Andy Lyon,

  Ms. Drummond, Zack, Captain Carr, and Deputy Chief DuVally provided rebuttal
  to public comment.

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff, Ms. Drummond,
  Captain Can, Deputy Chief DuVally, Sergeant Sonderland, Joyce Chang, and Ted
  Pao.

RECESS  At 7:28 p.m.. Mayor Riggins recessed the meeting. The meeting resumed at 7:42
  p.m. with all Councilmembers present.

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tern Silverstein moved, and Councilmember Uhring seconded a motion
  to approve the Conditional Use Permit (CUP) for a period of one year. During that
  time, the City shall retain a consultant to evaluate and explore feasible alternative
  solutions that address both the public safety needs and the community's concerns
  regarding the appearance of the tower. At the conclusion of the one-year period, the
  matter shall return for further consideration. If a workable alternative solution is
  identified, the CUP shall not be granted, and the applicant shall pursue the
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of Decemeber17, 2025
  Page 3 of 3

  alternative solution. If the consultant determines that no feasible alternative exists,
  the tower will remain in its current location.

  The motion was withdrawn by the maker.

MOTION  Councilmember Stewart moved, and Mayor Riggins seconded a motion to adopt
  Resolution No. 25-50 with modification to condition 19 to state "Per the applicant's
  request, a deed restriction shall be recorded that prohibits the tower from being
  leased or used by any entity other than the County of Los Angeles for the purpose
  of the county providing emergency communications for LASD city, county, state,
  or federal government emergency responders- , and approved the formation of a
  City Council Ad Hoc composed of Councilmember Conrad and Mayor Riggins to
  determine the color of the tower. The question was called, and the motion carried
  4-1, Councilmember Uhring opposed.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Riggins adjourned the meeting at 8:47 p.m.in memory of Rob and Michele Reiner

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  City of Mali u on August 10, 2026.

  -  BURC SIL N4( RSTEIN, Mayor
